purpose: Teach: 富豪/調教/落胆/軍部/反感/進入/出没/盗作

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外の富豪を主要顧客として開拓しろ
lines.en: Go develop wealthy overseas clients as our primary customer base.
lines.style: Measured command delivered with quiet authority. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with precision. No performance—this is how decisions sound.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の調教ではなく、対話の文化を作ります
lines.en: Understood. We'll build a culture of dialogue rather than top-down instruction.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation with steady confidence. Slight lean-in to show he's understood the distinction. Clear, methodical. The tone of someone taking on real responsibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場で落胆させる商品は出すな
lines.en: And don't let us put disappointing products on the market.
lines.style: Firm directive with no room for compromise. Quiet intensity. The words are simple but the expectation behind them is not.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。軍部関連の受注は慎重に判断します
lines.en: Understood. We'll evaluate military contracts with appropriate caution.
lines.style: Professional, measured response. A beat of weight on the word 'appropriate'—he knows what's at stake. Not defensive, just honest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の反感を招かないよう経営しろ
lines.en: Make sure we run this company in a way that doesn't breed resentment among staff.
lines.style: Steady, almost matter-of-fact direction. But there's something deeper underneath—this isn't just business policy. It's a value. Slight slowness on the final clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫への不法進入を防ぐセキュリティを強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen security to prevent unauthorized warehouse access.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment with the tone of operational problem-solving. Clear, efficient. The confidence of someone who knows how to execute what's being asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ニセモノが出没する市場には注意しろ
lines.en: Watch out for markets where counterfeits are circulating.
lines.style: Pointed caution delivered without alarm. The tone of someone who's seen this pattern before. Slight emphasis on 'watch'—this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の盗作行為は厳罰で対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond to any plagiarism or intellectual property theft from staff with strict penalties.
lines.style: Final confirmation, direct and unambiguous. The pace picks up slightly—this is the close of the conversation. No hedging.
